summary: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech includes a monthly free usage limit per voice type: 4 million characters each for Standard and WaveNet voices, and 1 million characters each for Neural2, Studio, Chirp 3: HD and Polyglot (Preview) voices. Billing must be enabled to use the API, and usage above the free amount is charged automatically. Gemini-TTS and Instant custom voice have no free usage. Voices cover many languages, for example fr-FR and vi-VN Neural2, WaveNet, Standard and Chirp 3: HD voices. Publishing terms are unclear: neither the pricing page nor Google Cloud's terms say anything either way about publishing audio generated in the free tier, so check with Google before relying on it.
claim_steps: Create a Google Cloud project and enable billing on it.
Enable the Cloud Text-to-Speech API in that project and create credentials for it.
Synthesize speech with a voice from the supported voices list; usage under each voice type's monthly free limit is not charged.
Set a budget alert, because characters beyond the free amount are billed automatically.

social_proof.title: Text-to-Speech pricing | Google Cloud
social_proof.text: You must enable billing to use Text-to-Speech, and will be automatically charged if your usage exceeds the number of free characters allowed per month. Free usage limit: WaveNet 0 to 4 million characters; Standard 0 to 4 million; Neural2 0 to 1 million; Studio 0 to 1 million; Chirp 3: HD 0 to 1 million.
